commands.name: loadout
commands.description: Pick the theme (terminal, avatar, Flow map, frames); "/loadout help" lists the rest
commands.argumentHint: [<theme> [here] | follow | avatar | flow | frames on|off | background on|off | style pixel|text|auto | status | help]
commands.output:
Loadout: not read yet (the global theme). Pick one in the Avatar pane, or by name.
Themes: auto, dark, light, light-daltonized, dark-daltonized, light-ansi, dark-ansi.
Change it: /loadout <theme> (every terminal) · /loadout <theme> here (this terminal) · /loadout help.

commands.name: colors
commands.description: Turn the coloured row frames on or off
commands.output:
Colours off: every row is drawn as Claude Code draws it. /colors turns them back on.
Also: /loadout frames on|off.
